text_block_list.text: One day, while thinking over the upcoming race schedule by myself...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I came because there is something I would like to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you picking races rather thoughtlessly?
Running so many races in a row will prevent you from demonstrating your full power.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To fulfill our clan's golden rule,
and ensure we radiate our greatest brilliance...
I believe we should deliberate once more.

Daiichi Ruby's point was entirely justified.
I decided to reconsider our upcoming race schedule.
